docs.text: Fast Load import ( "context" "fmt" "log" "time" teradata "github.com/atl3/go-sql-teradata" ) func fastLoadDemo() { cfg := &teradata.Config{ Host: "...", User: "...", Password: "...", } ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 120*time.Second) defer cancel() // Create Connection fcon, err := teradata.NewFastLoadConnection(cfg) if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) } defer fcon.Close() // Begin Load tx, err := fcon.BeginFastLoad(ctx, "DATABASE_NAME", "TABLE_NAME", "COL1", "COL2") // ... if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) } defer tx.Close() // Load for i := range 10000 { _, err = tx.AddRow(ctx, i+500, fmt.Sprintf("FastLoad Demo %d", i)) if err != nil { tx.Abort(ctx) log.Fatal(err) } } // End results, err := tx.End(ctx) fmt.Printf("RowsSent=%d, RowsAccepted=%d, UniqueViolations=%d\n", results.RowsSent, results.RowsAccepted, results.UniqueViolations) if len(results.Errors) > 0 { fmt.Println("Errors:") for _, e := range results.Errors { fmt.Printf(" - FastLoad Error: RowNumber=%d, Column=%s, ErrorCode=%d\n", e.RowNumber, e.Column, e.ErrorCode) } } }

docs.text: LOB LOB Without Prefetch Enabled import ( "database/sql" teradata "github.com/atl3/go-sql-teradata" ) func main() { ... var ( id int64 clob teradata.TeradataClob blob teradata.TeradataBlob ) for rows.Next() { err := rows.Scan(&id, &clob, &blob) clobVal, err := clob.GetString() blobVal, err := blob.GetBytes() ... } ... } LOB With Prefetch Enabled func main() { ... var ( id int64 clob sql.NullString blob []byte ) for rows.Next() { err := rows.Scan(&id, &clob, &blob) ... } ... }
